stem.en: Kabir asks why withdrawal "comes out already tagged, for free, when deposit cost a coin per bead". Where did the free tag come from?

text.en: From the deposit. The coin spent on each bead going in built a link that holds enough free energy to pay for a phosphate coming out. The tag is that coin, partly refunded.
From the phosphate in the water.

feedback.en: Phosphate is free; putting it on a glucose is not. The link's own fall pays for it.

text.en: From glycogen phosphorylase, which supplies energy.

feedback.en: Enzymes pay nothing. They lower humps. The energy is in the link.

text.en: It is not really free; a coin is spent somewhere hidden.

feedback.en: The catch is at deposit time. Nothing is hidden; it was paid then.

explanation.en: Follow the coin. Deposit stores it in the link. Withdrawal by phosphate gets some of it back as a tag. That is why banks store energy as links, not as coins.
